body.intent: Fix Ship-change's landed-green step fails instead of waiting when the PR's CI has not finished: nebari run 01M6WFRNHPRB (change set 01M6W90N0DB7, PR #83) was retried after a fix pushed head 5c49fea, and landed-green failed at once with 'PR #83 at 5c49fea: not settled: 0 of 8 checks finished', ending the run. A pending check is not a failure: landed-green (like wait-pr and rebased-green) should poll until the checks settle or a timeout passes, and fail only on a real red. Unstuck by waiting for CI by hand and resuming with --retry.
